# Elaro Digital

> Digital marketing agency in Bihar delivering SEO, Meta Ads, Google Ads, website development and lead generation for local and pan-India businesses.

Elaro Digital is headquartered in Gaya, Bihar and serves clients across Patna, Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga, Bhagalpur, Purnia and all India.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, results and industries served.
- [About](/about): Team, mission and approach.
- [Services](/services): Full list of digital marketing services.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Case studies and client results.
- [Testimonials](/testimonials): Client reviews.
- [Courses](/courses): Digital marketing courses for students and business owners.
- [Blog](/blog): SEO, ads and growth articles.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email and office address.

## Services

- [SEO Services](/services/seo-services): Technical, on-page and Local SEO.
- [Social Media Marketing](/services/social-media-marketing): Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube.
- [Meta Ads](/services/meta-ads): Facebook and Instagram advertising.
- [Google Ads](/services/google-ads): Search, Performance Max, YouTube and Shopping.
- [Website Development](/services/website-development): Business sites, ecommerce and landing pages.
- [App Development](/services/app-development): Android, iOS and Flutter apps.
- [Graphic Design](/services/graphic-design): Branding and marketing creatives.
- [WhatsApp Marketing](/services/whatsapp-marketing): Broadcasts, automation and Click-to-WhatsApp ads.
- [Lead Generation](/services/lead-generation): Landing pages, funnels and CRM integration.
